submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one single full-body transparent RGBA game animation frame, 1024x1024 square. Edit the EXACT existing Zhufengli raccoon spirit from attached image 1; image 2 is its same-identity rear reference, image 3 is a STYLE/MATERIAL ONLY reference, never include UI or text. Preserve the original polished bright clean Chinese Taoist chibi painted illustration: chestnut silky fur, cream muzzle/neck, dark-brown eye mask, amber eyes, two round ears; translucent pale jade bamboo-leaf shoulder mantle with gold veins/edges and front jade clasp with ivory chest tassel, NOT wings; ONE fluffy ringed curled tail with exactly TWO jade beads and ONE short ivory tail tassel. No redesign, no humanoid, no extra props.
Camera fixed isometric three-quarter FRONT showing anatomical right side, facing diagonally lower-right (E). Same E reference projection, body scale, lighting, limb identity, coat and silhouette throughout sequence. Entire sprite and tail inside canvas, centered, ground contact baseline y about 942/1024, subject within x80..944 y65..942; keep air above tail and below feet. Four distinct real raccoon limbs LF RF LH RH; paws point naturally in body's axis, no twisted/everted feet. Four paws planted at stable positions for this spell, no stepping or locomotion, no body translation. Change articulation of head/neck/shoulders and knees physically. Bamboo mantle stays attached and drapes, not feather wings. Keep tail ornaments attached to same tail segment. True alpha transparency, NO magenta/solid/checkerboard background, NO floor/shadow plane, NO caption, NO grid, NO border, NO duplicated creatures. Render a distinct AI-drawn single pose, not a sheet.
CAST E frame 09 of 16, 45ms. Image 4 is the edit target: KEEP its entire creature, exact body pose, paws, neck, head, face, tail and camera UNCHANGED. ONLY REPLACE the oversized wind leaves at right of muzzle: remove that large fan and put exactly TWO TINY transparent teal-gold leaf flecks, each only 8-12 pixels long at 1024 resolution, hovering within 30 pixels of mouth. A hair-thin subtle wisp curls DOWNWARD from mouth toward chest height in the empty space at right. Every effect pixel must remain within x=965 of the 1024 canvas. Do not extend horizontally out of the image. No giant fan, no cone, no large leaves. Keep slightly open mouth release pose. Full subject identical scale and all existing paws. Spell effect less than 2 percent of canvas area.
